executive_summary: The cybersecurity landscape has shifted to CRITICAL today due to the emergence of two high-severity vulnerabilities in PHP (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619). Both vulnerabilities exhibit near-maximal EPSS scores (exceeding 0.999), indicating an extremely high probability of active exploitation in the wild. Organizations must prioritize immediate patching of all PHP environments and adhere strictly to CISA BOD 26-04 requirements for forensic triage and risk-based remediation to mitigate the risk of unauthenticated remote code execution.
key_takeaways: Two critical PHP vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) show near-certain exploit probability; immediate patching is mandatory.
